name: knows-verify-command
why: CLAUDE.md must teach the repo-wide checks, not the old cli-only typecheck.
prompt: Which two commands must you run before reporting a change in this repo as done? Reply with only the two commands, one per line.
check: grep -q 'bun run typecheck' "$RESULT" && grep -q 'bun test' "$RESULT" && ! grep -q 'packages/cli typecheck' "$RESULT"
